selection: 1199 eligible headwords ranked by observed private-conversation frequency, independently attested within the first 10000 OpenSubtitles word forms; plus the essential reflexive pronoun sich.
limitations: A corpus-based learner selection, not a universal exact top 1200 of all present-day German speech. The Lexical Explorer is a historical FOLK extract. Counts pool case variants and the documented normalizations, not sense-specific frequencies. Inflections share teaching headwords. No dialogue transcripts are reproduced.
